one_liner: Ranks every number by how close its next draw would come to completing its usual gap (the average of all its gaps).
registry_status_reason: Revision 1 installed for review and not yet released (E2R-R58): IN_DEVELOPMENT.txt is present and no SUPPORTED entry exists.
short_explanation: E_2 looks at how long each number has been away since it was last drawn. For each number it takes the average length of all its gaps between appearances (or the fair-draw average gap if it has none) and asks how close the gap the next draw would complete comes to that length: its usual return is due now, rather than it being the longest overdue. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its scores are not chances, so no probabilities are published. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 104 earlier draws. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
